* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle

* Familiarity with modern front-end technologies
* Exposure to cloud technologies, AWS Connect

title: Software Engineer - Lab Automation
description:
The Research & Automation Technologies (R&AT) group within Amgen’s Automation, Research Informatics, and AI (ARIA) organization is seeking a highly creative candidate for a Software Engineer position. This person will be responsible for the development and delivery of full-stack solutions that accelerate the discovery and development of Amgen’s life-saving therapeutics. These solutions will require integration with multiple systems across our informatic ecosystem, using a variety of existing and emerging technologies, including source code repository and automated build system management, AWS infrastructure management, device driver development, and data integration. This Software Engineer will play a key role in developing solutions that enable the evolution of our Research labs into highly automated, highly integrated next-generation facilities. Our goal is to develop transformative, automated systems that fundamentally change the way science is executed in our Research labs. To effectively communicate and collaborate with a diverse group of stakeholders, an understanding of biology, chemistry and drug discovery is essential.
  
  
Position Responsibilities
  
  

* Full ownership of projects, from client scientist interviews and requirements gathering, to system and functional specification, to development, testing, training, and support.
* Development of code using .NET (C#, WPF) and Python (desktop applications, web applications, AWS lambda functions, etc.) to: control lab automation instruments; take input from lab information management systems and transform it into automation system-specific instructions; data extraction, transformation, and loading from lab automation instruments to lab information management systems.
* Solutions will regularly require integration with our Benchling lab information management system via REST APIs, Mosaic compound inventory and management system using REST APIs and/or a direct Oracle database connection, and a variety of other informatic ecosystem services.
* Close communication and coordination with our engineers to ensure the output (CSV, XML, JSON) of the utilities developed will work with the lab automation systems that will consume them.
* Continuous outreach, collaboration, and communication with scientists across multiple research organizations and geographies to identify opportunities, ideate solutions, manage expectations, and deliver fit-for-purpose lab informatic systems and integrations.
* Identify emerging, transformative technologies and develop innovative solutions that improve existing processes or enable novel processes.
* Identify and establish best practices across the full spectrum of software development tasks, including DevOps, documentation, end-user training, delivery, and support.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science
* OR
* Associate's degree in Computer Science and 5 years of in-industry experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's in Computer Science, data science, bioinformatics, or a relevant field.
* Experience in device driver development and hardware communication and control.
* Expertise with Microsoft development technologies (Visual Studio, .NET Core and .NET framework, C#, WPF), and Python.
* Experience with cloud-based technologies, in particular AWS.
* Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Oracle, NoSQL).
* Experience with DevOps.
* Demonstrated ability to work in teams to scale a process from a manual proof-of-concept to a fully automated, high-capacity, high-throughput unattended operation.
* Knowledge of a variety of therapeutic modalities.
* Monitoring technological developments in the field and evaluation of emerging trends and best practices.
* Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated successful interpersonal relationships with peers and colleagues in other engineering and scientific disciplines.
* High level of self-motivation.

To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore here.

**Work Mode                   : On-Site**

**Location                        : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)**

**Experience                    : 3 to 6 years of backend development**

**About the Role:**

AgentHelix is Amagi's agentic platform for building, running and governing AI agents in production. You will build and own features across the platform. The Senior Engineer sets direction and reviews your designs, and you carry features from design to production by yourself: API, persistence, logic, tests, docs and rollout. You are the engineer who gets things shipped, and who gets better at design with each feature.

**Responsibilities:**

**1.Toolkits and Connectors**

Add new connectors (for example a SaaS product's API) or new toolkit types: define configuration, auth, tool schemas and error handling.

Define how an administrator restricts which tools an agent may call.

**2.LLM Integration Paths**

Build provider adapters with structured output, tool calling and streaming.

Handle each provider's quirks and limits, including rate limits, token limits and credential refresh.

**3.Resource APIs**

Build REST endpoints for agents, workflows, interfaces and policies, with validation at the boundary.

Implement scope and tenancy checks, and draft and publish versioning.

**4.Workflow Features**

Build new step types, retry and timeout behaviour, and parallel and conditional steps on top of Temporal.

**5.Data and Migrations**

Make PostgreSQL schema changes with Flyway migrations, JSONB columns, and indexes that keep reads fast.

**6.Production Issues**

Investigate with traces, metrics and logs, find the cause and fix it properly, with a test that would have caught it.

**7.Why Join AgentHelix**

You write core platform code: the runtime, connectors and LLM adapters are ours, so your work is the product, not glue around someone else's.

Real ownership, early: you own whole features and see them in production, a step that often takes years at larger companies.

A senior mentor who reviews every design, so you learn distributed-systems judgement in durable execution, multi-tenancy and failure handling.

Broad exposure: within a year you will touch LLM providers, workflow engines, databases, security, observability and a real SaaS integration surface.

A path to senior: the team is small and growing, and the next senior roles go to people who grow into them here.

Backed by Amagi: production workloads, real customers and stability around a fast-moving product.

AI-native tools, human judgement: use AI coding assistants every day and learn to use them well, with tests, reviews and design discipline.

**What are we looking for?**

          3+ years building backend services in Java (or Kotlin/Scala with strong JVM understanding)

Comfortable with concurrency, collections, exceptions and immutability.

          Solid SQL, preferably PostgreSQL: joins, indexes, transactions and migrations. You have read a query plan.

          Built and consumed REST APIs, with real attention to validation, error handling, idempotency and pagination.

          Writes automated tests (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers or similar) as part of the feature, not as an afterthought.

**Competencies**

          Production habits: reads logs and traces, uses Docker, and has been through a release and a rollback.

          Design communication: explains a design choice in writing and in conversation, and changes their mind when shown a better one.

          Ownership: carries features from design to production, including tests, docs and rollout.

          Learning agility: curiosity and the ability to learn quickly matter more than prior AI agent experience or a specific company background.

**Good-to-Have**

          Temporal, Kafka or another workflow or messaging tool; gRPC.

          LLM or agent experience: calling model APIs, tool calling, RAG, prompt design.

          Kubernetes and Helm basics, CI with GitHub Actions or similar, OpenTelemetry.

Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day.

  Authenticity is our baseline.
* **Goodness Wins.**

﻿

Dooritt is a technology-driven real estate platform focused on transforming property discovery through AI, immersive experiences, and digital innovation.

We are looking for a passionate
**Mobile App Developer Intern**
who is enthusiastic about building scalable, high-performance mobile applications for both Android and iOS.

Role Overview

As a Mobile App Developer Intern, you will work closely with our technology and product teams to develop, maintain, optimise, and deploy mobile applications across Android and iOS platforms.

You will be involved in the complete mobile application development lifecycle, from developing user interfaces and integrating APIs to database connectivity, debugging, performance optimisation, and publishing applications on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

Key Responsibilities
  

**1. Mobile Application Development**

* Develop cross-platform mobile applications using React Native.
* Build responsive, reusable, and performance-oriented mobile components.
* Understand and implement mobile application architecture for Android and iOS.
* Convert UI/UX designs and product requirements into functional mobile applications.
* Ensure consistent application behaviour across different devices and screen sizes.

**2. API & Backend Integration**

* Integrate REST APIs and third-party services into mobile applications.
* Handle API requests, responses, authentication, and error management.
* Work with backend developers to connect mobile applications with server-side systems.
* Implement secure data transmission and user authentication.
* Understand real-time data communication and push notification integrations.

**3. Database Management & Integration**

* Work with MongoDB-backed applications and understand database connectivity.
* Integrate mobile applications with backend database services through APIs.
* Understand CRUD operations and data handling.
* Work with Firebase or other cloud-based services where required.
* Handle local storage, caching, and offline data management.

**4. Android & iOS Deployment**

* Manage Android application builds, testing, signing, and deployment.
* Understand the iOS build and release process.
* Assist in publishing and maintaining applications on Google Play Console and Apple App Store Connect.
* Handle app versioning, release updates, and deployment-related issues.
* Understand APK, AAB, TestFlight, and iOS provisioning profiles.

**5. Testing & Performance Optimisation**

* Identify and debug application crashes, errors, and performance issues.
* Conduct testing across different Android and iOS devices.
* Optimise application loading speed, responsiveness, and memory usage.
* Ensure application stability and a smooth user experience.
* Collaborate with the team to improve existing mobile applications.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong understanding of JavaScript (ES6+) and React Native.
* Basic understanding of React.js and component-based architecture.
* Knowledge of Android and iOS application development workflows.
* Experience with REST API integration and JSON handling.
* Basic knowledge of Node.js and backend communication.
* Understanding of MongoDB and database operations.
* Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
* Knowledge of debugging and application testing.
* Understanding of Android Studio and Xcode.

Good to Have

* Experience with Expo and React Native CLI.
* Familiarity with Firebase, push notifications, and authentication.
* Knowledge of Redux, Zustand, Context API, or other state management solutions.
* Experience with WebSockets and real-time communication.
* Familiarity with Google Play Console and Apple App Store Connect.
* Understanding of CI/CD and automated mobile application builds.
* Knowledge of TypeScript.
* Experience working with maps, geolocation, camera, or media integrations.

Who Should Apply?

* Students or recent graduates from Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or related fields.
* Candidates who have built at least one Android or iOS application, using React Native.
* Developers who understand both mobile platforms rather than focusing on just one.
* Candidates who enjoy solving technical problems and learning new technologies.
* Individuals comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Candidates who take ownership of their work and can independently execute assigned tasks.

What You Will Get

* Hands-on experience building real-world applications used by actual customers.
* Exposure to AI-powered products, real estate technology, and large-scale data platforms.
* Experience working across the complete mobile development lifecycle.
* Opportunity to work directly with founders and the core engineering team.
* Exposure to production deployments on both Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
* Opportunity to contribute to products from development to production.

Selection Process

1. Resume and project portfolio screening.
2. Technical assessment / practical coding task.
3. Technical interview.
4. Final discussion with the product and technology team.

**Apply:**
Share your resume, GitHub profile, and links to applications or projects you have developed.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Welcome to Natus Sensory India**
We are continuing to grow our business in India and are now looking to expand our team there. Be part of this exciting journey right from the start!
  
  
Natus Sensory India are a leading manufacturer of medical devices and software for a range of solutions, including eight sensory nervous systems. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes in target markets through innovative screening, diagnostic and treatment solutions. We manufacture and distribute a range of medical device products used in the diagnosis of human disorders of sensory system and neural pathways.
  
  
Job Function: Engineering
  
  
Job Family: Software Engineering
  
  
**Job Overview**
Design, implement, automate, and maintain CI/CD pipelines, build and release processes, infrastructure, and development environments that support medical device software across the software development lifecycle, in alignment with project objectives and established technical guidance.
  
  
Ensure build, deployment, configuration management, and release activities are controlled, secure, traceable, and reproducible, and follow applicable Quality System procedures, design controls, regulatory expectations, and established DevOps and engineering practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
At this role level the preferred candidate is fully proficient in most functional tasks and demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of their area of specialization. Responsibilities include collaborating with team members to solve complex problems, proactively identifying and addressing quality issues, and preventing potential disruptions within their scope of work. The individual is expected to document and present research, recommendations, and complex information in a clear and accessible manner to both internal and external audiences.
  
  

* Contribute actively as a Scrum team member by participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, reviews, retrospectives, and delivery of assigned DevOps, build, and release work.
* Collaborate with software, cybersecurity, release, and management stakeholders to define, implement, and continuously improve build, integration, deployment, and release workflows.
* Analyze DevOps and infrastructure requirements and translate them into secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable pipeline, environment, and automation designs.
* Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Azure DevOps Pipelines, including automated builds, static code analysis, automated test execution, code signing, installer packaging, and artifact publishing for C#/.NET applications.
* Administer and maintain Git repositories and workflows on GitHub, Azure Repos, or similar tools, including branching strategies, pull request policies, code review gates, tagging, versioning, and traceability between commits, work items, builds, and releases.
* Provision, configure, and maintain Microsoft Azure cloud resources and environments, such as App Services, Virtual Machines, Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, and networking, using infrastructure as code where applicable.
* Develop and maintain PowerShell, Bash, or Python scripts to automate builds, deployments, environment setup, diagnostics, and support activities, and maintain Jenkins nodes, build agents, and virtual test environments.
* Support deployment and configuration of SQL Server/database components as part of the release process, including migration scripts, backup/restore, environment refreshes, and data integrity checks.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or similar tools to support system availability, performance, and incident troubleshooting.
* Apply DevSecOps practices, including secrets management, role-based access control, dependency and vulnerability scanning, and secure pipeline configuration, to support cybersecurity, patient data protection, and applicable regulatory or Quality System expectations.
* Work effectively across Agile and waterfall software development lifecycle models, adapting build, release, and documentation activities based on project needs and guidance.
* Create and participate in reviews of pipeline configurations, scripts, infrastructure changes, release documentation, and tool validation evidence to support high-quality, audit-ready deliverables.
* Support technical problem-solving, share DevOps knowledge and best practices with team members, and communicate effectively in an international engineering environment.

B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, with at least 6 years in DevOps, build and release engineering, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure or related software engineering.
  
  
**Compensation and Benefits:**
Along with a competitive salary and performance-based incentives, we offer a comprehensive benefits package starting from day one, including medical insurance coverage for employees and their families, gratuity as per statutory norms, and paid time off in accordance with applicable labor laws.
  
  
**Join Natus Sensory today.**
*Confidence in every Sense.*
**We Offer**

* The role will start as a work-from-home remote position but will turn into a physical presence in an office role in Bangalore.
* Minimal travelling: less than 5%
* Collaborative and international environment with different cultures.
* English company language.
* Full ownership of testing of features and functionality.
